notes: Shot list: the film and, per landmark, its role in it, hero framing (class, distance), context framing and the detail budget that follows from it. The film block and the segments mirror the compiled film (data/tour/timeline.json via src/tour/compile.ts; `pnpm check` keeps them in sync).

detail.policy: Fixed design scale per landmark (never distance-dependent). Hero silhouette spans >= 25 % of frame height at `-close` and stays below 0.6x the host relief within 20 km; `-wide` extent >= places.json wideShotPxTarget (A 30 / B 16 px) or the landmark carries an emission / contrast cue; wide shots (>300 km) rely on terrain silhouette, contrast halo and emission sparkles. minFeatureKm = minFeaturePx x heroKm / 1427.

kings-landing.framing: from the south-east over the river mouth: the Red Keep on the High Hill over the river cliff in the right third, the roofs climbing to the Great Sept's dome and crystal towers on Visenya's Hill (left), the Dragonpit's broken drum on Rhaenys's Hill behind, the wall round it all; afternoon sun from the south-west
features: the Red Keep: pale red stone, seven drum towers with iron ramparts, the barbican, Maegor's Holdfast
the Great Sept of Baelor: seven crystal towers
the Dragonpit, its dome fallen in
the city wall and its seven gates
the Mud Gate and the riverfront

winterfell.framing: from the south-east over the winter town and the main gate: the two grey walls, the Great Keep and the Great Hall, the First Keep beside the broken tower's jagged top, the godswood's dark crowns with steam rising, the glass gardens along the south
features: two curtain walls, the inner higher, moat between
the Great Keep, the Great Hall
the First Keep and the broken tower
the godswood, heart tree and hot-spring steam

casterly-rock.framing: from the Sunset Sea in the late sun: the Rock's banded sea face rising from the water with its carved galleries and sea cave, the crown of gold-capped towers, Lannisport's red roofs and harbour at its southern foot
features: the Rock rising from the sea

highgarden.framing: from the south-west across the Mander in the morning: the three white rings and the dark briar maze between the outer two, slender white towers round the keep, orchards and coloured fields of flowers on the hill
features: gardens, orchards and fields of flowers

harrenhal.framing: from across the Gods Eye at evening: the colossal dark curtain on the shore, the five slumped, melted towers, the Hall of a Hundred Hearths inside, a few lights in a castle too big for its household
features: the Hall of a Hundred Hearths

the-eyrie.framing: from the south-south-east, level with the shoulder in the morning: the seven slender white towers bunched on their crag at the end of the spur against the sky, the rope down to Sky, the Lance rising on the right toward its snowy head
features: the crag and its sheer face
Sky, Snow, Stone and the trail

storms-end.framing: from Shipbreaker Bay south-south-west of the castle under a storm sky, the coast running away behind: the headland's sea cliffs, the sloping unbroken curtain and the colossal drum tower crowned with heavy battlements (the spiked fist on its arm)
features: the sloping curtain without slits or posterns
the sea cliffs and the sea passage

dragonstone.framing: from the south-west at dusk: the black castle of dragons on the Dragonmont's spur, towers crowned by crouching and rearing dragons, gargoyles along the walls, the Stone Drum lit at its top, the smoking Dragonmont behind
features: the Great Hall a lying dragon

castle-black.framing: from the east-south-east along the Wall in a low pale sun: the ice rising a kilometre over the open spread of towers and halls at its foot, the King's Tower a third of its height, the timber stair zigzagging up the south face, the cage on its chain
features: the Wall, seven hundred feet of ice
the King's Tower, the Lord Commander's Tower, Hardin's Tower, the Shieldhall
the zigzag timber stair and the winch cage

the-wall.framing: the Wall running away east and west across the far north from Castle Black, the Haunted Forest beyond it, the Gift on this side

the-twins.framing: from downstream in the afternoon: the twin grey castles face to face across the Green Fork, the arched bridge between their gatehouses and the Water Tower in the river at its middle

riverrun.framing: from down the Red Fork in the morning: the castle's point where the Tumblestone joins the Red Fork, its walls rising from both rivers, the Wheel Tower's waterwheel and the Water Gate, the moat beyond
features: the moat and its sluice gates
the Wheel Tower and its waterwheel

pyke.framing: from the sea to the south-west under a grey sky: the stacks in a row off the cliffs, the Great Keep, the Kitchen and Bloody Keeps and the Sea Tower farthest out, the stone and rope bridges between them

oldtown.framing: up the Whispering Sound in the afternoon: the Hightower on Battle Isle at the river mouth, its beacon lit, the walled city behind, the Citadel along the Honeywine

sunspear.framing: from the sea to the north-east in the late afternoon: the Old Palace on the corner of the spit, the gold dome of the Tower of the Sun and the Spear Tower, the Winding Walls and the Shadow City behind
features: the Tower of the Sun's gold dome

moat-cailin.framing: from the bog to the south-south-west under a grey afternoon: the causeway coming up out of the swamp to the Gatehouse Tower, the leaning Drunkard's Tower and the tall Children's Tower among fallen basalt

eastwatch.framing: from the bay to the south-south-east under a grey sky: the castle and its quay on the shore, the ships, the Wall's ice running down to the sea behind it

white-harbor.framing: from the water to the south-west in the morning: Seal Rock before the waterfront, the white city climbing to the New Castle, the Wolf's Den at the river mouth, the Sept of the Snows' dome

greywater-watch.framing: low over the mire at dawn: black pools, reeds and drowned trees fading into mist; no castle shown, the Watch is somewhere within

inn-at-the-crossroads.framing: from the south-south-west at dusk: the inn's lit windows on the crossroads, the kingsroad running north past it, the river road and the high road branching off

isle-of-faces.framing: low from the south-south-west at dawn into the grove: the great weirwoods round the clearing, white trunks and red leaves, their carved faces turned inward
features: the red-wooded isle in the Gods Eye

summerhall.framing: from the south-west in the late light: the roofless great hall's window piers against the sky, the scorched towers and the broken curtain on the hill, trees grown up in the wards

starfall.framing: from the estuary to the south-west in the afternoon sun: the island castle in the river mouth, the Palestone Sword standing pale over the sea, the bridge to the east bank behind
features: the bridge to the east bank

water-gardens.framing: from the sea side to the south in the late afternoon, up the chain of pools and fountains between the orange trees to the pink marble palace and its arcaded terrace
features: the pink marble palace and terrace

fist-of-the-first-men.framing: from the forest to the south-south-east under a grey sky: the stony hill standing above the trees, the broken ring of piled stones round its level top
